title: Workforce Intelligence plugin for Copilot Cowork enters Frontier preview on 16 November
summary: MC1552389: from 16 November 2026, tenants enrolled in the Frontier programme can make the Workforce Intelligence plugin available in Copilot Cowork. Managers can ask natural-language questions about headcount, roles, reporting lines, management layers, locations and (with People Skills licensing) skills. Microsoft states the plugin does not grant extra access: answers follow existing permissions, connected sources and admin-configured governance labels, and it is not designed for monitoring, performance management or ranking employees. Admin setup of Workforce Insights is required.
why: HR and org data in an AI surface is a GDPR and works-council topic, and in the EU an AI Act question if anyone tries to use it for evaluating staff. The guardrails are Microsoft's stated intent, not a technical block, so your own policy has to say what is allowed.
todo: Check whether your tenant is enrolled in Frontier and who can enable plugins in Copilot Cowork.
Before enabling: review which workforce attributes are connected and how governance labels restrict them.
Involve HR, privacy/DPO and (where applicable) employee representatives; document permitted use cases.
Add an explicit 'no individual performance evaluation' line to your AI acceptable-use policy.
